correctness.rationale: Reassessed the corrected iff: either label order of the alternating partition is specifically included, and the signed witness interchanges its two words under complementation. Constant colors and singleton partitions are reversible; the latter are stationary alternating renewal by the strong Markov property and independence of singleton holding time from its exit. Conditional on the color of the origin, equilibrium length bias and uniform age in the central sojourn give a reversible stationary law because the flanking intervals have identical independent alternating laws on the two sides. The adjacent-pair case has fixed entrance state in each color and independent sums of two exponentials. For opposite pairs stationary traffic J fixes a fair Palm phase, and direct conditioning gives E[UV_+]-E[UV_-]=(1/a-1/c)(1/b-1/d)/2. Reversal swaps the flanking marks on a typical 1-run; entry and exit conventions count the same complete runs. For the converse, the stationary reversed jump from i is to i-1 at rate r_i, so reflection swapping either pair of equal-rate opposite sites identifies forward and reverse generator, stationarity and labels. Independently enumerated the exponential-series coefficient using signed stay steps (-r_i) and advances (r_i), with initial weights J/r_i and accepting only endpoints of the required parity after each gap; after dividing by J the coefficients are 0,0,0,(a-c)(b-d). The corrected proof also obtains this by exact one-jump time integration (signed cubic cross multiplier 13/6) and the three compatible three-jump counts across the gaps (volume multiplier 7/6 and opposite signed rate sum). Stationarity forces the reversed pairs of length at most three consecutive equal-grid symbols to agree; fixed-lag persistence by continuity is valid at small positive reverse rates. Positive finite affinity gives finite positive entropy production, not a binary estimate thereof. Read the attached checker but did not execute it; the exact enumeration and analytic survival-volume calculation are independent of its finite tests. All rates and scope in the corrected statement and slogan agree with the proof.

value.rationale: A complete exact visibility classification on the smallest heterogeneous ring separates microscopic circulation from an observable time arrow and distinguishes a topology/colouring effect from rate contrasts. Its two explicit signed tests connect path monitoring to equally spaced measurements, and the bidirectional perturbation shows the witness does not require infinite cycle affinity. This is a meaningful precise benchmark, without claiming estimates of dissipation or finite-sample power.
